name: a_oil_energy
prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Monday October 5, 2026. Topic: Oil & energy.

Window: Friday October 2, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET) through Monday October 5, 2026 12:20 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. This spans 2 non-trading day(s): news published on those days (e.g. Saturday and Sunday) is in scope and often the most important. Anything published after 12:20 ET on Monday October 5, 2026 is out of scope.

FIND
WTI and Brent (settle, % change, contract month), natural gas, gasoline and diesel prices (AAA/EIA), EIA inventory data, OPEC+ actions, energy policy (export bans, SPR), energy-stock analyst actions, energy M&A (acquirer, target, $ value), activist stakes in energy companies.

Run multiple searches with different phrasings and dates. Prefer primary sources and wire services
(Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's, Investopedia, company press releases, SEC
EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Census/Fed releases, FDA). For every item give the latest status as of the cutoff.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar /
Pharma / Energy / Retail, or a concise sector name. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.

## WTI and Brent — Oil Prices `[Energy]`
- **WTI** November 2026 futures settled at **$89.34 per barrel**, down **$3.53**, or **3.8%**, on Friday, October 2; the contract month was not specified in the cited report. (Reuters, Oct 2, 2026, 07:29 ET)
- **Brent** December 2026 futures were quoted at **$99.74 per barrel**, down **$2.57**, or **2.51%**, at **06:35 ET** on October 2; the contract month was not specified in the cited report. (Reuters, Oct 2, 2026, 06:35 ET)
- **Brent** crude futures traded at **$101.59 per barrel**, down **$0.66**, or **0.65%**, at **10:40 PM ET** on October 4; **WTI** traded at **$90.12**, down **$0.95**, or **1.03%**. Contract months were not specified. (Reuters, Oct 4, 2026, 06:20 PM ET)
- **Brent** crude futures traded at **$101.59 per barrel**, down **$0.72**, or **0.71%**, at **02:34 AM ET** on October 5; **WTI** traded at **$90.05**, down **$1.05**, or **1.2%**. Contract months were not specified. (Reuters, Oct 5, 2026, 02:34 AM ET)

## Natural Gas `[Energy]`
- U.S. working natural-gas inventories were forecast at **3,969 billion cubic feet** on October 31, 2026, **5% above** the 2021–2025 five-year average and **1% above** October 2025. (EIA, Oct 1, 2026; updated Oct 3, 2026)

## OPEC+ `[Energy]`
- Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Kazakhstan, Algeria and Oman agreed on October 4 to keep **November 2026 oil-production targets unchanged** from September levels. (Reuters, Oct 4, 2026, 10:05 AM ET)
- The seven OPEC+ members produced approximately **25 million barrels per day in August**, up **630,000 barrels per day** from July and approximately **5 million barrels per day below** their combined February pre-conflict level. (Reuters, Oct 4, 2026, 10:05 AM ET)
- OPEC+ still had approximately **2 million barrels per day of production cuts** covering most members; its next seven-member meeting was scheduled for **November 1, 2026**. (Reuters, Oct 4, 2026, 10:05 AM ET)
- November production targets were listed as **10.478 million barrels per day for Saudi Arabia**, **9.949 million for Russia**, **4.431 million for Iraq**, **2.676 million for Kuwait**, **1.628 million for Kazakhstan**, **1.007 million for Algeria**, and **841,000 for Oman**. (OPEC+ statement reported by Investing.com, Oct 4, 2026, 05:41 AM ET)

## G7 Emergency Energy Reserves and Export Policy `[Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics]`
- G7 countries agreed on October 2 to release up to **100 million barrels of diesel and crude from emergency reserves** and pledged to refrain from energy-export restrictions after pressure from U.S. President Donald Trump. (Reuters, Oct 5, 2026, 06:20 AM ET)

## Energy Supply and Geopolitics `[Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics]`
- Rising Middle East crude exports and the planned G7 reserve release were reported as increasing available supply while Gulf energy-infrastructure risks continued amid the U.S.-Israeli war against Iran. (Reuters, Oct 5, 2026, 06:20 AM ET)
- European gasoil futures fell approximately **5%** on October 2 after reports of additional diesel and crude-stock releases. (Reuters, Oct 2, 2026, 07:29 AM ET)
